free_text: A biopsy is recommended because the patient has a prior positive biopsy for ISUP Grade Group 1 carcinoma, shifting the question to whether the cancer has progressed. This is supported by the rising PSA from 4.6 ng/mL to 7.7 ng/mL over 12 months and the PI-RADS 3 finding, which together indicate a need for re-evaluation despite the prior diagnosis.
